hints: Set $y = \frac{2x + 3}{x - 1} \implies xy - y = 2x + 3 \implies x = \frac{y + 3}{y - 2}$ to get $g^{-1}(x) = \frac{x + 3}{x - 2}$.
Identify $x \neq 2$ as the undefined value for $g^{-1}$.
walkthrough:
Find the inverse function $f^{-1}(x)$ for $f(x) = 3x - 2$:
$$y = 3x - 2 \implies 3x = y + 2 \implies x = \frac{y + 2}{3} \implies f^{-1}(x) = \frac{x + 2}{3}$$

Find the inverse function $g^{-1}(x)$ for $g(x) = \frac{2x + 3}{x - 1}$:
$$y = \frac{2x + 3}{x - 1} \implies y(x - 1) = 2x + 3 \implies xy - y = 2x + 3$$
$$xy - 2x = y + 3 \implies x(y - 2) = y + 3 \implies x = \frac{y + 3}{y - 2}$$
$$g^{-1}(x) = \frac{x + 3}{x - 2}$$

State the undefined value where the denominator becomes zero:
$$g^{-1}(x) \text{ is not defined for } x = 2$$

ai_rubric.Inverse Functions: States $f^{-1}(x) = \frac{x+2}{3}$ (B1). Isolates $x$ for $g^{-1}$ (M1) and states $g^{-1}(x) = \frac{x+3}{x-2}$ (A1). States $x \ne 2$ (B1).

walkthrough:
Form the composite expression $fg(x)$ and set it equal to $\frac{7}{3}$:
$$fg(x) = 3\left(\frac{2x + 3}{x - 1}\right) - 2 = \frac{7}{3}$$

Add $2$ to both sides and divide by $3$:
$$3\left(\frac{2x + 3}{x - 1}\right) = \frac{7}{3} + 2 = \frac{13}{3} \implies \frac{2x + 3}{x - 1} = \frac{13}{9}$$

ai_rubric.Composite Function Equations: Sets up $fg(x) = 7/3$ (B1). Collects terms into linear equation (M1). Obtains $x = -8$ (A1).
